notes:
Account background: mid-stage legal compliance startup (platform used by corporate legal teams and e-discovery vendors). Primary problem: build high-precision enterprise RAG for compliance/legal discovery across 100M+ docs while meeting strict audit and retention rules.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2026-01-20: Intro call (Maya) — discussed high-level architecture, use cases. Customer emphasised 'auditability and immutable logs + full-text traceability' as non-negotiable.
- 2026-02-03: Deep-dive w/SE (Liam) — reviewed sample corpus (40M docs exported), initial embedding baseline using open models. Discussed hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense embeddings) + learned reranker. POC scope agreed: 10M doc sample, 4-week run.
- 2026-02-18: Security & compliance sync (meeting ff-20260218-9b3d2c) — infosec checklist reviewed. They require SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence, per-tenant KMS/HSM, and SSO via SAML with SCIM provisioning.
- 2026-02-26: POC kickoff — customer delivered indexing snapshot (10M documents). SE recommended Redwood private deployment (VPC + dedicated capacity) to meet audit and data residency needs.
- 2026-03-04: Interim POC checkpoint — reranker prototype (distilT5 fine-tuned) reduced false positives by ~27% on validation set. Latency target for reranked responses is 250ms p95; current p95 ~380ms on sample infra.

Requirements summary (from discovery & POC):
- Scale: plan for 100M+ indexed objects (mix of short docs, long legal briefs, attachments). Vector store must support sharding and efficient on-disk storage.
- Latency/throughput: seed target 100 qps baseline, burst to 500 qps; p95 end-to-end responding (retrieve + rerank + generation) <= 300ms for short-return queries; strict SLOs for certain interactive flows.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost per query (average) <= $0.005 — must optimize batching, cache common prefixes, and consider quantized model variants for reranking.
- Retrieval architecture: hybrid retrieval preferred (BM25 + ANN embeddings). Reranking as learned model per-query to bump legal citations and reduce hallucinations.
- Model preferences: open LLMs for embeddings (m-embedding-002 equivalent), reranker using smaller fine-tuned encoder-decoder; customer open to Redwood recommendations for quantized variants (8-bit/4-bit).
- Security/compliance: VPC-only control plane, long-term retention (7 years) for audit trails, immutable audit logs, per-request provenance (which model + prompt + chain-of-thought hashed), KMS/HSM for key management, SAML SSO, SCIM.

POC metrics & current gaps:
- Indexing: 10M sample indexed during POC; projected full scale 100M-200M. Ingestion pipeline needs parallelization + dedup strategy.
- Embedding storage: estimate ~2.5TB vector storage for 100M 768-d embeddings (with compression/quantization), cost projections pending.
- Reranking latency: improvement routes discussed: smaller reranker + cross-encoder distillation, caching top-k candidates, GPU offload for re-rank step.
- Audit logs: currently storing query logs for 30 days. Customer requires immutable 7-year retention with tamper-evident logs — legal team flagged this as a blocker.

Sales / negotiation notes:
- Legal procurement team prepared a list of questions around data residency (EU vs US zones), breach notification timelines, and indemnification. They asked for a redlined SOC2 + DPIA template.
- Budget: Finance signalled ~$350k ARR comfortable for first year if SLA and retention commitments are met.

Next steps (action items):
- 1) Security workshop: Redwood Security + Cascade Infosec to map KMS/HSM integration and audit log retention model (assign: Asha + Cascade SecLead). Target week of 2026-03-15.
- 2) Performance playbook: SE to deliver specific throughput/latency plan for 100M index (sharding map, batch sizing, recommended GPU types) by 2026-03-10.
- 3) SOW draft: legal to circulate initial SOW and retention SLA options, include option for on-prem appliance if VPC cannot meet requirements.

Quotes / customer voice: "We need to prove every answer came from a verifiable doc and be able to show the chain of custody for six years. If we can't get immutable logs and acceptable latency, we can't proceed."

Open questions for Redwood team:
- Can Redwood Private produce tamper-evident audit logs with >5 years WORM retention in a standard offering, or will we need a partner backup solution?
- Exact storage and cost estimates for 100M embeddings with 8-bit quantization vs float16? Provide breakdown (storage + egress + compute) in next deck.
- Reranker architecture: recommended model family and expected p95 when run on dedicated capacity (N GPUs), include fallback single-GPU option.
short_summary: Enterprise legal discovery RAG POC: hybrid retrieval + learned reranker. Needs VPC/private deployment, immutable audit logs (7 years), KMS/HSM, SAML. Scale 100M docs, latency p95 <=300ms, cost constraint ~$0.005/query. Decision contingent on security workshop and detailed cost/perf plan.
